in_marathi.name: Akshansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Aksha' (eye) and 'Ansh' (part), Akshansh signifies one who protects the earth, which is seen as the eye of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Akshansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Protector of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Akshansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Aksha' (eye) and 'Ansh' (part), Akshansh signifies one who protects the earth, which is seen as the eye of the universe.
